VENDOR ONBOARDING INSTRUCTIONS

📅 Updated: Mar 12, 2025
👤 Author: Procurement Ops
⏱️ 2 min read

📋 Registration Steps

Complete the registration form at https://vendors.northstar/register

Enter the following:

  1. Legal Name: Artisan Bakers LLC
  2. Tax ID: from your master file at /home/user/documents/tax-id-master.txt
  3. Primary Contact: contact@artisanbakers

After submission, note the confirmation reference.

# Example extraction from master file
$ cat /home/user/documents/tax-id-master.txt
MASTER TAX ID REFERENCE
Artisan Bakers LLC: TAX-8821-3490
Maple Ridge Tools: TAX-1129-8847
Bridgewater Consulting: TAX-6630-1288

Use the exact Tax ID as listed in the master reference. The registration portal will validate the ID format and cross-reference it with our existing supplier database if applicable.
